items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: The interviewer mentions meeting Robert, but the interviewee (Buzzy Williams) does not respond or provide any personal connection or interaction with Robert.

ctx.x: Do that with a pencil and paper though. That's before things happen. Yeah, I remember Robert years back. I just met him once in a bar, you know, but he seemed to...
He always wear tansy during an hour and store at me. Really, yeah?
